fields.description: Rule label is a free name used only for reading the grid.
fields.label: Rule Label

fields.description: The declared field whose answer this rule reacts to. Left blank, the rule declares the form's opening state and applies before anything is answered.
fields.label: When Field

fields.description: How the answer is compared. `is set` and `is not set` ask only whether an answer exists and ignore the Value.
fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
is
is not
is set
is not set

fields.description: The answer compared against. It is refused unless the When Field offers it as an option.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: What happens when the condition holds. A hidden field is never required and its value is never accepted, so chained rules resolve without ordering.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: The declared fieldnames the Action applies to, comma-separated. Add target below appends one without typing.
fields.label: Targets

fields.description: Add target appends a picked field to Targets and clears itself.
fields.label: Add Target
